mapper.select: SELECT id, name, category_id, price, image, description, status, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user FROM dish WHERE category_id = #{categoryId}

SELECT d.id, d.name, d.category_id, d.price, d.image, d.description, d.status, d.create_time, d.update_time, d.create_user, d.update_user, c.name as categoryName FROM dish d left join category c on d.category_id = c.id
AND d.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
and d.category_id like concat('%',#{categoryId},'%')
and d.status like concat('%',#{status},'%')
order by d.create_time desc

SELECT d.id, d.name, d.category_id, d.price, d.image, d.description, d.status, d.create_time, d.update_time, d.create_user, d.update_user FROM dish d, setmeal_dish sd WHERE d.id = sd.dish_id AND sd.setmeal_id = #{id}
SELECT id, name, category_id, price, image, description, status, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user FROM dish WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dish (name, category_id, price, image, description, status, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user) VALUES (#{name}, #{categoryId}, #{price}, #{image}, #{description}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{createUser}, #{updateUser})
